title: GDCGenomicsQC: Reproducible Ancestry-Aware Genomic Quality Control in Controlled-Access Computing Environments
description: GDCGenomicsQC is a configuration-driven Snakemake workflow for genomic quality control and ancestry-aware preprocessing in controlled-access computing environments. The workflow supports genotype conversion, genome-build harmonization, sample and variant quality control, relatedness assessment, reference-projected principal component analysis, and global ancestry classification. Public synthetic test fixtures and documented validation evidence support inspection and reproducibility of the tested workflow paths. Optional downstream modules are not claimed to be fully validated by these tests.
